item.title: Buy the Option, Not the Province
item.description: Several work possibilities have become real at once, but a faster licensing path is a reason to wait for demonstrated demand, not a reason to pre-buy another province. This episode builds a one-page expansion gate around actual file volume, total attention cost, regulator requirements, and fixed fees. It also catches two less obvious edges: incorporation can change WorkSafe Personal Coverage eligibility, and Gemini’s privacy treatment differs between Workspace surfaces and personal Connected Apps. The work shield is a next-workday quarantine for non-urgent conflict drafts, with clear exceptions for safety and formal duties. The family move protects one unclaimed, phone-free transition in a Saturday already rich with sport, art, and a match. It favors quiet optionality over speculative administration and stimulation.
